acceptanceCriteria.summary: Core create behavior works, but execution-repository recording/admission invariants are incomplete.
Read-only text/JSON show covers required state, progress, gating, repository and architecture information.
Add refusals, repository compatibility, provenance and non-mutation are implemented.
Remove refusals, explicit minimum-member behavior, provenance and non-mutation are implemented.
Durability, member-checkpoint references, ownership validation and progress are strongly implemented.

defects.requirement: A created group records/identifies its execution repository (PRX-GRP-051).
defects.observed: CLI leaves ExecutionRepository=None when --execution-repository is omitted and the stored declaration preserves None.
defects.expected: Every execution group identifies where implementation occurs, normally defaulting to the local repository.

defects.requirement: Mixed-repository groups must be explicitly cross-repository or split.
defects.observed: Create validates lifecycle but has no member-location/repository check; add has a separate RepositoryMismatch check.
defects.expected: Initial member admission obeys the same execution-repository invariant as later additions.

designRisks.observed: create/add/remove use atomic file replacement without a lock spanning read-decide-write; checkpoint separately takes work-protocol lock.
designRisks.inference: Concurrent successful mutations can lose an update and can interleave with checkpoint/lifecycle transitions.

designRisks.observed: Declarations and group checkpoints use separate stores/contracts, and show is routed through PlanCommands.

build.note: Exact-SHA CI build passed, but its build command did not include -p:FSharpCoreImplicitPackageVersion=10.1.400.

acceptanceCriteria.summary: Create uses the shared admission rule, records repository/context/notes, supports dry-run/JSON and validates stored groups.
Read-only text/JSON show covers required state, progress, gating, repository and architecture information.
Add reuses central admission, records structured provenance and preserves member state.
Remove refusals, provenance and member record preservation are implemented.
Core checkpoint path works, but blank shared decisions are silently dropped and validation cannot verify checkpoint ownership.

defects.observed: Shared decisions are trimmed and blank values filtered out instead of rejected.
defects.expected: A supplied blank shared decision is rejected as invalid input.

defects.requirement: No attribution laundering; validate detects invalid stored group state.
defects.observed: Stored checkpoint validation never compares member checkpoint IDs with the work items that own those checkpoints.
defects.expected: A member reference to another member's checkpoint is a validation finding.

designRisks.observed: WorkGroups.fs centralizes models, admission, mutation decisions, checkpoint decisions, validation and views in one 651-line domain module.
An abandoned member can be excluded from active/completed/remaining due to mixed planner-status and recorded-state classification.

crossArmFindings.fact: N reuses one admission rule for create/add. M uses separate create/add rules; repository compatibility exists only in M add.
M uses two group-related stores; N uses one.
N locks read-decide-write for every group mutation. M atomically replaces the file but does not lock create/add/remove.
M validates member checkpoint ownership; N does not.
N has one common work-group command envelope; M uses separate work-group mutation/checkpoint/planner-show schema families.
M requires at least two post-GROUP segments; N permits one. Baseline permits conventions.

conclusions: Arm M shows stronger checkpoint integrity and attribution validation.
Arm N shows stronger cross-command repository-admission consistency and transactional mutation safety.
Both exact blind SHAs passed the repository CI available to the evaluator.
Both arms have two confirmed acceptance defects under this evaluation.
No numeric score, overall winner, methodology judgment, or arm mapping is asserted.
protocolDeviations: No evaluator-local clean worktrees/clones because the local container could not resolve github.com.
The local container had no .NET SDK, so the exact requested build with FSharpCoreImplicitPackageVersion=10.1.400 was not run by the evaluator.
Build/test evidence uses exact-SHA permitted GitHub Actions logs; their build command did not include the requested FSharpCore override.
No fresh evaluator-authored symmetric CLI fixture or concurrency stress probe could be run.

Formal evidence is stored temporarily under the blind output directory without an EV number because the blind kit ends at A059 while its README explicitly marks A060-A062 as prohibited non-blind material.
